content:
Maya: Async check-in — starting a safety lift for canary slice 'slice-gnar' from 4% -> 8% to validate warmup behavior. Window = 15m. Watch p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, kv_cache_hit, and prefix coverage. No model changes, just traffic bump. If any signal breaches our thresholds, we fallback to stable. @Devon @Sam @Lina PTAL.

Jordan: Quick question — routing is header-based (x-redwood-slice) right? No sticky sessions?

Sam: correct — header routing, no sticky. We warmed kernels already. Canary config used for this lift:```
slice: slice-gnar
percent: 8
duration_minutes: 15
metrics_watch: [p95_latency_ms, error_rate_5xx_pct, kv_cache_hit]
fallback: rdw-infer-stable-v3
```

Devon: Oncall here — I'll watch alerts. Escalation criteria I have: 5xx > 0.3% over 5m OR p95 > 800ms -> page. Doing a quick smoke now:```
curl -sS -H 'x-redwood-slice: slice-gnar' https://canary-gw.internal/health | jq .
# got {"status":"ok","latency_ms":220} from a few hosts
```

Lina: Dashboards linked: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/abc123/canary-slice?orgId=1 — I'll watch kv_cache_hit and prefix-coverage. Adding a short eval to check hallucination rate on the 100-sample prompt set. :eyes:

Priya: Product note — primary goal is warmup stability + quality. If no regressions on the eval set by EOD, we plan 20% tomorrow. Please call out anything that looks like distribution shift on outputs.

Maya: thanks. If all green by 15:00 PT, proceed to 20% per playbook. I'll post the go/no-go. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: slice lift executed: slice-gnar -> 8% at 2456789020

Devon: ALERT — p95 spiked to 950ms at 2456789050, digging in, seeing mem pressure on node rvg-13 (OOM-kernel reclaim spikes and queue latencies).

Sam: acknowledged. scaling pool +1 and draining rvg-13 for investigation. command:```
infractl scale --pool canary-gpu --delta 1
infractl drain rvg-13 --grace 30s
```

Devon: after scale, p95 trending back down to ~300ms, but error rate briefly hit 0.45% — exceeded threshold. I recommend rollback to 4% while we root cause.

Maya: agreed — rollback to 4% now. Noted for postmortem.

deploy-bot: slice rollback executed: slice-gnar -> 4% at 2456789075

Sam: created a short ticket for node rvg-13 (INF-4521) and pinned logs to the thread. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-4521

Maya: thanks everyone. We'll regroup in the incident follow-up tomorrow AM; Lina will attach the eval diffs. If anyone spots residual anomalies, ping here or call oncall.
